name: Vervet monkeys
summary:
Vervet Monkeys is a Gorilla Tag fan game that brings players into a vibrant world of fast-paced movement, social interaction, and exciting gameplay. In this immersive VR experience, players take on the role of agile vervet monkeys, using their hands to climb, jump, and swing through dynamic environments.
